stories.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI has the biggest launch in history
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI was released on 19 November 2026 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. It sold 32.5 million preorder copies and generated US$3.79 billion within 24 hours of its release, the largest entertainment launch in history. Approximately 75% of the preorders were made for PlayStation 5.

stories.headline: Mongolia's president leaves office after a parliament vote
stories.summary: The State Great Khural, the Mongolian parliament, has accepted the resignation of president Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh by 96 votes to 8. He had served as the country's sixth president from 2021. Under Mongolian law the parliament's speaker, Sandagiin Byambatsogt, has taken on the presidential duties until a new president is elected within four months.

stories.headline: Interlocking bricks printed from simulated Moon soil
stories.summary: Researchers at the University of Arkansas have turned simulated lunar regolith into interlocking bricks. They used a 3D printing technique called laser powder bed fusion. They were the first to fuse the material into construction blocks without adding a binding agent.
